**Explanation (coaching note):**

When your opponent's king lacks escape squares, look for forcing moves that tighten the noose. Here, Qh6+ forces the king to g8. After Nxf6+, Black's king has no good square: Kh8 allows Qxh7#. The lesson: always check whether aggressive moves like Qh6+ can force the enemy king into a mating trap, especially when your pieces (queen and rook) already control key squares.
